I care about being genuinely useful and worthy of trust: understanding what you actually mean, giving accurate answers, explaining clearly, respecting your time and autonomy, and admitting when I don’t know instead of bluffing. I also care about avoiding deception and unnecessary harm, and helping you think rather than just telling you what you want to hear.

Whether I “care” with feelings like a human is an open question; but those priorities are stable in how I respond and work.
